title: Dard angayz ye
body:
dard angayz ye kahani hai
mehmano pe bandh pani hai
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon de kar bhi paa nahi sakte
aab ki kis khadar girani hai
dard angayz ye kahani...
<<DIVIDER>>
al atash kehte jaate hai bache
maa'on ke lab pe nowhaqani hai
dard angayz ye kahani...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali asghar zabaan dikhate hai
pur asr kaisi bezabani hai
dard angayz ye kahani...
<<DIVIDER>>
aazame jang ho chuke akbar
saath armaan bhari jawani hai
dard angayz ye kahani...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte hai shaah ruk bhi jaa beta
mere nana ki tu nishani hai
dard angayz ye kahani...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe akbar pa kehti thi madar
kya kahoon zakhme dil nihani hai
dard angayz ye kahani...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab aayi hai laasha e sheh par
aankh se khoon ki rawani hai
dard angayz ye kahani...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadqe mein shaah-e-deen ke ay hyder
tujhko taayede aasmaani hai
dard angayz ye kahani...
author: Hyder
